component.name: Catgirl Downloader
component.summary: Browse and save anime-style images from multiple sources

description.p: Catgirl Downloader is a desktop application for browsing and saving anime-style images from multiple online sources including nekos.moe, waifu.im, and Danbooru.
Built with Kirigami for seamless KDE Plasma integration, it features NSFW filtering, automatic image reload, Danbooru tag search, and easy one-click saving.
Initial release of Catgirl Downloader for KDE Plasma (Qt/Kirigami port)
